original.target_description: Articles a(n)/the: target-like use in Spanish teenage L1 Spanish–L2 English COREFL written narratives, beginners (A1+A2) versus intermediates (B1+B2), 2x2 chi-square on raw morpheme frequencies.

n.sample_role: Raw morpheme-frequency observations underlying the 2x2 test; analytic total not unambiguously established. Forty sampled texts/learners is the corpus size, not the number of independent frequency observations used in this test.
n.exclusions: Morpheme-specific annotation scope is described in accepted manuscript pp. 15–16. No test-specific exclusion count established.

es.location: Accepted manuscript p. 19, footnote 8; p. 23, section 4.4

p.location: Accepted manuscript p. 19, footnote 8; p. 23, section 4.4

notes: Original title and DOI verified against the deposited accepted manuscript at Universidad de Granada (https://digibug.ugr.es/handle/10481/97764). Accepted-manuscript pagination differs from the supplied published-page locator. Extracted the within-morpheme beginner-versus-intermediate contrast; did not substitute between-morpheme contrasts. Original analytic n left null: printed TLU ratios and the 40-text corpus total do not unambiguously establish the raw-frequency test denominator when non-target-like/oversuppliance annotations are included. Replication acquisition failed: supplied Helsinki download returned a bot challenge; handle inaccessible; legacy repository connection refused; an alternate legacy thesis path returned 404; repository bitstream API returned 401. No signed-in or paid acquisition used. Replication authors’ narrative verdict could not be inspected. The manuscript section 4.4 prints beginner TLU 211/386 while footnote 8 prints 311/386; preserved the identical printed chi-square/p without resolving this discrepancy.
